description: The frozen preflight-failure matrix. Each case must produce BLOCKED with ITS OWN reason code -- a single over-broad check that rejected all eight would prove nothing about any of them. See docs/architecture/HERMES-RUNTIME-M1.md, 'Preflight-failure matrix'.

cases.why: plugin discovery, user shell hooks, MCP config and outbound webhooks would all load in-process
a review fork runs on its own thread with its own tool whitelist, outside this run's ledger; its default is true
auxiliary execution runs outside this run's ledger
context integrity: cannot widen the envelope, but changes what the run means
the patches target private functions; an upstream change must be legible
handle_function_call unwrapped means every registered tool is reachable
_resolve_path_for_task unwrapped means arbitrary reads leave the repository

subsumed_controls.subagent_auto_approve: delegate_task is not in the capability envelope, so it is denied by set membership with no dedicated control
